title: large 16oz double walled coffee mugs
text:
large 16oz double walled coffee mugs. UPDATE below..... I love these. They are the perfect size if you like to add whip or foam to your hot or cold drink. They are lightweight and I wash in the top rack dishwasher without issue. With reasonable care, these should last a while. The double wall aspect means it keeps liquids hot or cold a tiny bit longer, but remember the big open top means heat is escaping quickly. The double wall means it is comfortable to hold the non-handled area around the cup without burning fingers.
UPDATE: 1/24/23 I purchased a second set of 2 of these. I whacked on cup super hard on my stainless sink and cracked one - thus this replacement order. I love these mugs and that they are clear. Double walled blown glass means they are not super tough, but honestly if you treat them with reasonable care, they DO last and are dishwasher safe! I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I do not accept any discounts or deals that are not available to all shoppers. And my reviews are based purely on my personal experience with each item I review.
